compute_mask_rcnn_loss: compute the mask prediction loss for Mask R-CNN using predicted mask logits and ground truth instances
calculate_mask_accuracy: calculate the mask prediction accuracy by comparing predicted logits against ground truth masks with a 0.5 threshold
crop_gt_masks_within_box: crop ground truth masks within proposal boxes to match the predicted mask dimensions for loss computation
handle_class_agnostic_masks: handle class-agnostic mask predictions by selecting the single mask channel when the number of classes equals one
log_mask_training_metrics: log the mask R-CNN training accuracy metric to the event storage for monitoring during training
